role_and_message.evidence: Preserves image synthesis versus synthesis with instance annotations, novel-category detection comparisons, and detection gains from InstaGen at limited real-data proportions.

panel_and_object_coverage.evidence: All three panels remain, including five Stable Diffusion examples, five annotated InstaGen examples, the method-comparison scatter plot, and both real-data performance curves.

labels_math_and_numbers.evidence: Original captions, method names, detector labels, Detection AP axes, and prompt text remain. Panel (c) retains 10, 25, 50, 75, and 100% ticks. Crowded or edge-truncated example labels are inherited from the source; the supplied pixel checks cover these retained blocks.

connections_and_direction.evidence: Detector ordering from Faster R-CNN through Deformable-DETR is unchanged. Bounding boxes remain associated with the same objects. Both performance curves increase with real-data proportion, with InstaGen consistently above the baseline.

visual_encodings.evidence: Example annotations retain green base-category and red novel-category encodings. Panel (b) retains red triangles for CLIP-based methods and a green circle for diffusion-based InstaGen; panel (c) retains red baseline squares and green InstaGen circles.

examples_and_data.evidence: The same photographic examples and annotated class identities remain. Scatter positions and curve measurements are preserved, including InstaGen near 42 AP in panel (b) and the larger performance gap at 10% real data in panel (c).

unsupported_additions.evidence: Added headings summarize the existing panels. The footer correctly describes the visibly different image rows as separate samples and directs readers to the existing local legends; it introduces no new result or method.

complete_visible_content.evidence: The full derivative contains all examples, plots, legends, axes, and original panel captions. No additional substantive clipping or missing content is apparent. Original annotation overlaps and boundary-truncated labels remain unchanged.

remaining_limitations: Assessment uses the supplied images, caption, and reported pixel-equality checks. Pixel proof applies only to the three listed source blocks; added headings, footer, and overall relationships were assessed visually. Retained source resolution and visual blemishes are independently scored; no quality-informed reroll.
caption:
Figure 1. (a) The synthetic images generated from Stable Diffusion and our proposed InstaGen, which can serve as a dataset synthesizer
for sourcing photo-realistic images and instance bounding boxes at scale. (b) On open-vocabulary detection, training on synthetic images
demonstrates significant improvement over CLIP-based methods on novel categories. (c) Training on the synthetic images generated from
InstaGen also enhances the detection performance in close-set scenario, particularly in data-sparse circumstances.
delegated_acceptance_review: Viewed full derivative and read eight source-pair checks against caption. Two five-example rows remain distinct sample collections; original annotation text, boxes, overlap and truncated edge labels are not guessed or repaired. Scatter and line chart retain original ticks, method labels and local encodings. New headings only name panels; footer explicitly prevents interpreting the two different rows as paired samples or conflating local legends. All three whole scientific blocks replay to original data.
